hooks.name: Design rules check
hooks.description: Checks stylesheet and page changes against the design steering rules

action.prompt: The file just saved changes how the site looks. Check it against .kiro/steering/design.md: no fonts loaded from another host (no fonts.googleapis.com or @import url(http...)); no headings set to all capitals; buttons use the book serif; the Old Numbers font only where a number is the point. Report anything that breaks a rule and fix it. Do not touch anything else.
